svg.title: Baffin Current: conditional regional geographic floor
svg.desc: Conditional geographic floor 1,000 km from nominal 67 to 76 degrees north. Not a mapped current route or whole-current length. Source summer near-surface extent uses a historical northern naming extension. Nine editorial scenarios span 892.6 to 1,115.8 km; these are not physical uncertainty or seasonal variability.

g.text: Rounded down to 100 km. No measured axis or guaranteed physical minimum.
Not source position error, a confidence interval or a seasonal range.
Summer 1978/1979 context; exact gate dates and a common fixed layer unknown.
Fissel et al. (1982), pp180,183: author extends the name north to Lady Ann Strait.
Lancaster excursion and meanders are not reconstructed. Calculation longitude is abstract.
Scalar diagram only · doi:10.14430/arctic2318 · no new ranked whole-current length
